I spent 15 minutes generating the copy that Angela Tseng will share with the participants coming to the cacao circle on the 22nd of April Earth Day. 

Agroverse, a TrueSight DAO initiative, regenerates our Amazon rainforest by backing ceremonial cacao grown on regenerated land via traditional agroforestry previously harmed by soybean farming and cattle ranching. Farmers benefit from 48% of sales, surpassing the usual 6% offered by conventional intermediaries. Experience this innovative and sustainable approach at SF Climate Week, where environmental conservation meets social responsibility.
